name: Telcordia GR-468-CORE test 5.20 temperature cycling of optoelectronic devices (-40 to 70 C or 85 C, >= 10 C/min, 100-1,000 cycles)
plain_name: Repeatedly swing laser and optical-network modules between -40 C and +70 C to prove they survive
description: Reliability qualification of laser modules and other optoelectronic devices per Telcordia GR-468-CORE 5.20: air temperature cycling from -40 C to +70 C (or +85 C) per MIL-STD-883 Method 1010 for 100-1,000 cycles at a minimum ramp rate of 10 C/min in a thermal-cycling chamber.
keywords: Repeatedly swing laser and optical-network modules between -40 C and +70 C to prove they survive

sources.citation: Telecordia GR-468-CORE for optoelectronic systems (ESPEC North America application page)

requirements.rationale: Test 5.20 cycles between -40 C (233.15 K) and +70 C (343.15 K).
Optional: the alternative upper limit of +85 C (358.15 K).
GR-468 5.20 requires a minimum temperature ramp rate of 10 C/min (10 K/min).

confirmation_note: Requirements taken from the cited procedure and independently re-verified against the source (research/v4, 2026-11-01). Users must confirm them for their own run; edits require confirmation again.
